title: Gizmo and the Fugitoid #1 2 Complete Set Mirage 1989 TMNT Michael Dooney Laird
condition_description: Both covers bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. #2 has light edge wear and a little toning at the top edge. See photos.
description:
Gizmo and the Fugitoid Book One (June 1989) and Book Two (July 1989), Mirage Studios - the complete 2-issue series, a Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles universe spinoff by Michael Dooney featuring Gizmo and the Fugitoid. Painted covers by Michael Dooney. Original $1.75 cover price each.

You get both issues:
- Book One - back cover: Melting Pot "Coming Soon" ad by Kevin Eastman and Eric Talbot
- Book Two - back cover: Commandosaurs ad by Peter Laird and Stephen Bissette

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
